title: AloPack
description: A ResourcePack themed around Alo_YouTube and his Personality
body:
⚔️ AloPack – The Ultimate PvP HUD
Welcome to the AloPack! Developed by the FloloreanerServer Team, this custom resource pack is completely themed around Alo_YouTube. It transforms your standard Minecraft interface into a vibrant, neon-pink, and highly competitive PvP HUD!

If you want a clean look with zero distractions, perfect visibility, and a sharp layout to dominate your fights, this pack is exactly what you need.

✨ Features at a Glance
🎯 Minimalist PvP Crosshair: Say goodbye to traditional, bulky crosshairs. This pack introduces a sleek white arrow (^) designed to give you maximum visibility and clean precision during intense sword, axe, or bow fights.

🍗 Neon Magenta Hunger Bar: The hunger icons have been completely redesigned into a bright, glowing pink/magenta color. It gives your hotbar a unique, modern edge.

⚡ Glowing Pink XP Bar: The experience bar features a smooth gradient shifting into an intense pink. The level counter sits cleanly on top, keeping your screen clutter-free when the battles heat up.

🎬 Inspired by Alo_YouTube
Every texture has been carefully designed to bring a bold, energetic, and highly recognizable pink aesthetic to your game. It’s the perfect way to combine sweaty competitive mechanics with the style of Alo_YouTube!

👥 Credits
Developer: Created and published by the FloloreanerServer Team.

Download the AloPack today and get the ultimate PvP upgrade!
